'''Kromo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] in the Forward Research Outpost in the bombed [[City/Legends|city]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kromo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a stimulant vendor on Taris.
